_comment: Ships with null rates by design. Populated at the start of a skill run by fetching the live pricing pages; report.py drops the cost column while rates are null. Never hand-edit stale values, and never commit populated ones — re-fetch. See references/pricing.md.
_model_keys_are_examples: Use the exact model ids the target repo calls, so report.py can match them. Canonical Claude ids carry no date suffix.
_expires: If a fetched rate is introductory or promotional, add an "expires" field beside it and surface that date in the PR body.
